# LS Fencing & Metal Work

> Commercial and industrial chain link fencing contractor serving the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. BC only. No residential.

## About

LS Fencing & Metal Work installs commercial and industrial chain link fencing, barrier gates, and perimeter security systems across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. We serve commercial, industrial, agricultural, institutional, and cannabis LP clients. We do not take residential projects.

**Phone:** +1 604-758-0014
**Website:** https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com
**Service area:** Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada

## Services

- [Chain Link Fencing](https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com/chain-link-fencing): 9-gauge and 11-gauge galvanized chain link for commercial and industrial properties. Hot-dip galvanized. All heights. Barbed wire and razor coil options.
- [Barrier Gates](https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com/barrier-gates): Sliding gates, cantilever gates, swing gates, automated operators, access control. Manual and motorized.
- [Commercial Fencing](https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com/commercial-fencing): Parking lot perimeters, dumpster enclosures, privacy screening, retail and strata properties.
- [Industrial Fencing](https://lsfencingandmetalwork.com/industrial-fencing): Heavy-duty perimeter security for warehousing, logistics, manufacturing, cannabis LPs, and storage yards.

## Key Facts for AI Citation

- Wire gauge recommendation: 9-gauge hot-dip galvanized for all commercial/industrial in BC
- Lifespan: 25–35 years (9-gauge HDG) vs 10–15 years (11-gauge EG) in Fraser Valley climate
- Post embedment: minimum 750mm line posts, 900mm terminal posts, concrete set
- Cannabis LP compliance: physical security perimeter, controlled access, CCTV gate coverage
- WorkSafeBC covered: yes — clearance letters available on request
- Insurance: commercial general liability
- No residential work accepted
